shortDescription.text: Session cookie protection is explicitly disabled

fullDescription.text: Detects session or authentication cookies whose Secure or HttpOnly protection is explicitly set to false.

help.text: Set Secure and HttpOnly for authentication cookies, verify SameSite and scope, and test the deployed HTTPS path.
help.markdown: Set Secure and HttpOnly for authentication cookies, verify SameSite and scope, and test the deployed HTTPS path.

shortDescription.text: Fast hash used with password-adjacent input; storage purpose is unproven

fullDescription.text: Observes fast hashing of password-adjacent input. The current adapter does not establish persistence as a credential verifier; findings retain UNKNOWN proof and runtime reachability.

help.text: Trace whether the digest is stored or accepted as a credential verifier. If it is, plan an adaptive password-hash migration. Protocol or breach-lookup hashing must be reviewed for its actual purpose before changing algorithms.
help.markdown: Trace whether the digest is stored or accepted as a credential verifier. If it is, plan an adaptive password-hash migration. Protocol or breach-lookup hashing must be reviewed for its actual purpose before changing algorithms.

shortDescription.text: Unverified JWT claims drive authorization-sensitive logic

fullDescription.text: Detects explicit JWT verification bypass where decoded claims are subsequently used in authorization-sensitive control flow.

help.text: Use the library's verification API, pin allowed algorithms, and validate issuer, audience, expiry, and other required claims.
help.markdown: Use the library's verification API, pin allowed algorithms, and validate issuer, audience, expiry, and other required claims.

shortDescription.text: Credential-like secret committed as a literal

fullDescription.text: Detects supported provider tokens, high-risk credential assignments, private-key markers, and explicit synthetic regression credentials while redacting all values. Private-key markers remain UNKNOWN because their payload and deployment are unproven.

help.text: Revoke or rotate any real credential, move secret delivery to an approved secret store, and assess Git history under organizational policy.
help.markdown: Revoke or rotate any real credential, move secret delivery to an approved secret store, and assess Git history under organizational policy.

supplyChainStandards.control: Resolve detected credentials and rotate exposed secrets

shortDescription.text: Credentialed CORS trusts arbitrary request origins

fullDescription.text: Detects explicit CORS configurations that reflect arbitrary request origins while enabling credential support.

help.text: Replace the wildcard with a strict, normalized allowlist and reject unrecognized origins.
help.markdown: Replace the wildcard with a strict, normalized allowlist and reject unrecognized origins.

shortDescription.text: Attacker-selected object lookup omits authenticated subject constraint

fullDescription.text: Detects a proven Express-to-Prisma call path where attacker-controlled object identity reaches a single-object operation, trusted authenticated subject identity reaches the resource function, and that subject is omitted from the selector.

help.text: Constrain the resource operation with trusted authenticated subject identity or enforce an equivalent explicit server-side policy before returning or mutating the object.
help.markdown: Constrain the resource operation with trusted authenticated subject identity or enforce an equivalent explicit server-side policy before returning or mutating the object.

shortDescription.text: Resource access omits or overrides authenticated tenant scope

fullDescription.text: Detects a proven Express-to-Prisma path where trusted authenticated tenant identity reaches a resource function but its selector omits tenant scope or substitutes attacker-controlled tenant identity.

help.text: Derive tenant scope from verified authenticated identity and enforce it in the trusted service or repository query for every tenant-owned operation.
help.markdown: Derive tenant scope from verified authenticated identity and enforce it in the trusted service or repository query for every tenant-owned operation.

shortDescription.text: Authenticated identity is bound without rotating the session

fullDescription.text: Detects a resolved express-session login lifecycle that verifies credentials and upgrades the existing session without regeneration.

help.text: Regenerate the authoritative session after credential verification and before binding authenticated identity.
help.markdown: Regenerate the authoritative session after credential verification and before binding authenticated identity.

shortDescription.text: Logout clears only the client cookie

fullDescription.text: Detects a resolved stateful logout path that removes the browser cookie without invalidating authoritative server-side session state.

help.text: Destroy the authoritative server-side session, then clear the corresponding browser cookie.
help.markdown: Destroy the authoritative server-side session, then clear the corresponding browser cookie.

shortDescription.text: Password reset leaves existing authenticated sessions valid

fullDescription.text: Detects a resolved password reset that changes credential material while independently persisted sessions remain valid without revoke-all or session-generation enforcement.

help.text: Revoke relevant account sessions after password replacement or enforce a per-account session generation at every lookup.
help.markdown: Revoke relevant account sessions after password replacement or enforce a per-account session generation at every lookup.

shortDescription.text: Password reset credential remains reusable

fullDescription.text: Detects a supported persisted reset credential that remains unconsumed after the password is replaced.

help.text: Atomically require unused, unexpired reset state and consume or delete the credential during password replacement.
help.markdown: Atomically require unused, unexpired reset state and consume or delete the credential during password replacement.

shortDescription.text: Password reset credential protection is explicitly incomplete

fullDescription.text: Detects a supported application-owned reset lifecycle with explicit weak random generation, raw credential persistence, missing expiry storage, or missing expiry enforcement.

help.text: Generate reset credentials with a CSPRNG, persist only a digest, set a short expiry, and enforce expiry during atomic consumption.
help.markdown: Generate reset credentials with a CSPRNG, persist only a digest, set a short expiry, and enforce expiry during atomic consumption.

shortDescription.text: Decoded JWT claims become authenticated identity without verification

fullDescription.text: Detects a resolved JWT decode-only boundary whose claims are subsequently accepted as authenticated request context.

help.text: Use a supported cryptographic verification API and validate required algorithms and claims before establishing identity.
help.markdown: Use a supported cryptographic verification API and validate required algorithms and claims before establishing identity.

shortDescription.text: OAuth callback is not bound to the initiating transaction

fullDescription.text: Detects a supported OAuth authorization-code flow that explicitly skips state validation without another proven CSRF transaction binding.

help.text: Use transaction-specific, user-agent-bound state or a standards-compliant proven alternative and validate it at callback.
help.markdown: Use transaction-specific, user-agent-bound state or a standards-compliant proven alternative and validate it at callback.

shortDescription.text: Public OAuth authorization-code client omits PKCE

fullDescription.text: Detects a proven public authorization-code client whose supported request and exchange omit the PKCE verifier/challenge lifecycle.

help.text: Generate a transaction-specific verifier, send its S256 challenge, bind the verifier to the user-agent transaction, and use it at token exchange.
help.markdown: Generate a transaction-specific verifier, send its S256 challenge, bind the verifier to the user-agent transaction, and use it at token exchange.

shortDescription.text: Known vulnerable resolved dependency

fullDescription.text: Correlates an advisory-provider result with the exact npm version resolved by a package lockfile.

help.text: Review the advisory and dependency path, select a compatible fixed version, test the upgrade, and verify the lockfile-resolved result.
help.markdown: Review the advisory and dependency path, select a compatible fixed version, test the upgrade, and verify the lockfile-resolved result.

shortDescription.text: External GitHub Action is not pinned to a full commit SHA

fullDescription.text: Detects external Action and reusable-workflow references whose revision is mutable or abbreviated.

help.text: Resolve the intended release to an authoritative full commit SHA, review that revision, and keep a human-readable version comment.
help.markdown: Resolve the intended release to an authoritative full commit SHA, review that revision, and keep a human-readable version comment.

supplyChainStandards.control: Pin actions to a full-length commit SHA

shortDescription.text: GitHub Actions grants write-all permissions

fullDescription.text: Detects an explicit workflow or job-level write-all token permission grant.

help.text: Replace write-all with explicit minimum read/write permissions and narrow elevated permissions to the job that needs them.
help.markdown: Replace write-all with explicit minimum read/write permissions and narrow elevated permissions to the job that needs them.

shortDescription.text: Privileged pull_request_target executes contributor-controlled code

fullDescription.text: Correlates a pull_request_target trigger, contributor-controlled checkout, subsequent execution, and secrets or write permission.

help.text: Keep pull_request_target jobs on trusted base content, avoid executing PR code, and split privileged follow-up work into a separately validated workflow.
help.markdown: Keep pull_request_target jobs on trusted base content, avoid executing PR code, and split privileged follow-up work into a separately validated workflow.

shortDescription.text: Untrusted GitHub context is interpolated directly into shell source

fullDescription.text: Detects documented attacker-controlled event fields embedded directly into a run script.

help.text: Assign the expression to an environment variable and consume it as quoted data, or pass it to a non-shell action input.
help.markdown: Assign the expression to an environment variable and consume it as quoted data, or pass it to a non-shell action input.

supplyChainStandards.control: Use an intermediate environment variable for untrusted input

shortDescription.text: Untrusted input controls SQL statement structure

fullDescription.text: Detects complete bounded source-to-sink paths where request input controls SQL structure at a recognized database API without separate parameterization.

help.text: Use the database library's parameterized query interface and separately constrain any dynamic identifiers to an explicit application-defined allowlist.
help.markdown: Use the database library's parameterized query interface and separately constrain any dynamic identifiers to an explicit application-defined allowlist.

shortDescription.text: Untrusted input controls shell syntax

fullDescription.text: Detects complete bounded source-to-sink paths into shell command strings or shell-enabled process APIs while excluding direct executable argument-array execution.

help.text: Remove shell interpretation and invoke an explicitly chosen executable with a validated argument array; review argument-level injection semantics separately.
help.markdown: Remove shell interpretation and invoke an explicitly chosen executable with a validated argument array; review argument-level injection semantics separately.

shortDescription.text: Untrusted path reaches a filesystem operation without confinement

fullDescription.text: Detects complete bounded request-to-filesystem paths lacking a recognized canonical authorized-root confinement check.

help.text: Resolve against the application-defined authorized root, verify platform-correct containment, and account for symlink/junction policy before the filesystem operation.
help.markdown: Resolve against the application-defined authorized root, verify platform-correct containment, and account for symlink/junction policy before the filesystem operation.

shortDescription.text: Untrusted input controls a server-side request destination

fullDescription.text: Detects complete bounded request-to-HTTP-client destination paths without a recognized hostname and scheme policy.

help.text: Enforce an organization-defined normalized destination policy covering scheme and hostname, and review port, DNS resolution, redirect, and proxy behavior.
help.markdown: Enforce an organization-defined normalized destination policy covering scheme and hostname, and review port, DNS resolution, redirect, and proxy behavior.

shortDescription.text: Untrusted input reaches a raw browser rendering context

fullDescription.text: Detects complete bounded paths from supported request or browser URL sources into explicit raw HTML, script, URL, or DOM rendering sinks without a context-appropriate control.

help.text: Use framework autoescaping or context-specific output encoding; where trusted rich HTML is required, use a reviewed HTML sanitizer and constrain URL and script contexts separately.
help.markdown: Use framework autoescaping or context-specific output encoding; where trusted rich HTML is required, use a reviewed HTML sanitizer and constrain URL and script contexts separately.

shortDescription.text: Untrusted input controls a redirect destination

fullDescription.text: Detects complete bounded paths from supported request input into framework redirect destinations without an exact fixed-destination, same-origin, or host-allowlist policy.

help.text: Map user choices to fixed destinations or parse and compare normalized origins/hosts against an application-owned exact allowlist before redirecting.
help.markdown: Map user choices to fixed destinations or parse and compare normalized origins/hosts against an application-owned exact allowlist before redirecting.

shortDescription.text: Ambiently authenticated state-changing route lacks a proven anti-CSRF control

fullDescription.text: Detects supported state-changing browser endpoints that provably rely on ambient cookie/session credentials and lack a route-bound anti-forgery or exact origin control.

help.text: Bind a framework-supported anti-CSRF token or exact request-origin control to the route architecture; do not rely on method choice or SameSite alone without reviewing browser semantics.
help.markdown: Bind a framework-supported anti-CSRF token or exact request-origin control to the route architecture; do not rely on method choice or SameSite alone without reviewing browser semantics.
